title: Juwan Johnson 2023 Donruss Base #215 NO New Orleans Saints
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Get your hands on this 2023 Donruss Football trading card featuring Juwan Johnson of the New Orleans Saints. This sports trading card is a part of the base set and has the card number 215. It is perfect for any NFL fan or collector looking to add a card to their collection. The card is in English language and has not been autographed. 

The card is of standard size and has not been graded, not in original packaging or professionally graded. It was manufactured in the United States by Donruss in 2023 and is a part of the 2023 season. This card is a great addition to any collection and is perfect for showing off your love for football.
